description: Whether or not you ever wondered what would happen if one was to attach a sword atop a shotgun, the result of such an inquiry now rests before you in all its metallic glory.  Coming outfitted with a large 17 inch sword bayonet, an incredibly long barrel, and a wooden heat shield to protect the user's hands from the barrel when it heats up during firing, this pump-action shotgun practically drips menace and looks like it's straight out of the trenches of World War I.  There aren't any more trenches to clear, so the next zombie-infested town will have to suffice. This one is incredibly long, & can easily serve as a spear.

Named so after the notorious horse riders of the Glorious Empire that executed Republic soldiers with this very shotgun. This thing is heavier than your usual shotgun, and it can bore a huge hole into anyone or anything.

A very long single barrel shotgun, heavily modified. It is long enough to serve as a spear, but if only the creator weren't such an idiot. For *some* reason, they have mounted a large hammer on the end of a gun, resembling that of a clawhammer, w/ the pry as the sights. On the stock, lies a very large knife, sharp enough to cut you if you tried to shoulder this thing.



  "Roderick Ferrell and the Wendorf girl,"
  "they knelt down upon a darkened grave."
  "As he drew his dagger down, the blood ran to the ground,"
  "And they licked along the bloody blade."
  "Licked along that bloody blade."

  "As the blood-red blood spilled on the blue kentucky grass,"
  "A cry came out from that hallowed hunting ground."
  "'Twas the midnight curse of the bloody black patch,"
  "It had took another poor boy down."
  "It took another poor boy down."

  "Riding in the night down to F-L-A,"
  "To bid her folks a foul farewell."
  "With his clawhammer high, he drew their spirits nigh,"
  "and danced admist the crimson spray."
  "Danced admist that crimson spray."
